headline: A 2014 law renames a Dublin, California post office after James "Jim" Kohnen.
what_it_does: This law names the U.S. Postal Service facility at 6937 Village Parkway in Dublin, California, the "James 'Jim' Kohnen Post Office." It is a naming measure only. It does not change how the post office operates, what services it offers, or who it serves.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on August 8, 2014.
